name: JJGA 日本ジュニアゴルフ協会 — player profiles / member pages
publishes: No public player profile pages: /my/ redirects to /my/login/ (member-only mypage); the sitemaps (sitemap.xml, sitemap.html) list no player pages. Results exist only as per-event PDFs (see data/raw/jjga/_sources.json).
terms_note: JJGA Webサービス利用規約 https://www.jjga.org/common/pdf/agreement.pdf 第8条 (re-checked 2026-10-12): '当協会に無断で知的財産権を使用（複製、送信、譲渡、二次利用を含む）することは禁じます'. Anything JJGA-derived needs the owner's/JJGA's decision before publishing (source_terms.json: jjga- restricted).
reason: No public profiles, so no profile results to collect; no tournament files written here.

name: JJGA SAHARA ranking (JJGAランキング) 15～18歳 男子・女子
publishes: PDF per age division: 順位, 氏名, 合計/決勝/地区ポイント, ボーナス, 決勝・地区出場回数. No school, prefecture or age.
matching: name + gender + age band only: the 15-18 division on 2026-09-07 implies HS graduation 2026-2030, accepted when exactly one of our same-name players has a graduation_year in that range (weaker than JGA/WAGR matches). 265 entries -> 266 player_keys.
output: _jjga_rankings.json (same record shape as data/reference/player_rankings.json, system jjga). The leading underscore keeps build.py from reading it; it is NOT in player_rankings.json. Move the records there only if the owner decides to publish.
reason: Owner request (rankings); publication pending the terms decision.
